summary: Implemented and fully verified Phase 1 of 7 of the stack-PR-submission plan: review-stack-prepare.sh resolves the integration branch, review base (PD1, 5 refusals via distinct exit codes), remote, and platform (PD9, 3 refusals) for its cut/restack/show/record-request subcommands, backed by a 19-case fixture suite, repo-level-declarations.md documentation, and manifest/suite-classification registration. The phase's own scoped Batch Gate Deferral check (verify-touched.sh, 237 suites) reported only pre-existing/unrelated failures. Committed cleanly as one phase commit. Phases 2-7 (unit selection/ordering, the actual cut + manifest, restack, handoff integration, /merge stack mode, redeploy + second-repository demonstration) remain, each substantial git-plumbing and fixture work.
